request.description: Suspend a tenant: disables memberships and member logins.
Pause a tenant: disables memberships and member logins.
Reactivate a tenant: restores memberships and re-enables member logins.
Archive a tenant: disables memberships and member logins. Data preserved.
Soft-delete a tenant: status becomes Deleted, member users disabled. Data preserved.
